buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses VRRF : Applicable The procedures to be followed for registration of the firms for items other than t

extile fabrics and garniture are as follows: a) The firm should submit the VRR application through TCL OVR portal for registrati on. b) The firm should upload all the necessary documents as per VRR application in cluding technical documents pertain to essential plant and machineries, inspectio n/testing facilities, process flow chart and specification (if applicable) required to manufacture the item. c) On receipt of VRR online application, technical particulars should be verified for evaluation of capacity of the firm by the user section and based on the recom mendations of user section and then QAM team, firm can be registered in OVR po rtal for the item. Further, if OEM is foreign vendors, the firm who is sole selling/stockist/dealer of fore ign vendors should submit their VRR application in TCL OVR portal alongwith the foll owing documents for registration. i) The Firm should submit the online VRRF application for registration as “Authorised Dealer” for OEM of foreign vendors. ii) Authorised Dealer Notification from OEM in case of foreign vendors. iii) Genuineness of the Authorisation letter in OEM OFFICE LETTER HEAD issued to th e Factory. iv) Validity of the support for supply of Raw Material as Raw Material Assurance Certi ficate (RMAC) issued by OEM. v) Country of Origin certificate. Documents to be enclosed in the tender. 1. Standard Tender Enquiry of Procurement of Stores. (Annexure) 2. Additional Terms & Conditions & Instructions of Tender (ATC). 3. Specification. 4. Compliance Statement: The firm should submit the filled & signed copies of compli ance statement along with the technical bid. 5. Compliance Statement for Specification: The firm shall provide Compliance statem ent for all the parameters during bid participation and submit the filled & signed copi es of compliance statement along with the technical bid. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: OEMs/Manufacturers or their authorized dealers/ distributors/Sole Selling agents for t he tender store can only participate in the tender. Authorized dealers/ distributor/Sole selling agent of the OEM/ Manufacturer should submit the valid authorization certificate from the OEM along with Tender Enquiry. . 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
